Individual_Classification_Reason: Probabilities of dominant drivers are inferred, not observed or just standardised.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Estimate probabilities that macro/rates, sector, dealer/microstructure or NVDA-specific information currently dominates.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Estimate probabilities that macro/rates, sector, dealer/microstructure or NVDA-specific information currently dominates.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Underlying regime probabilities are inferred from features, not descriptive transforms.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Estimate probabilities of trend, mean reversion, range/pin, volatility expansion, contraction, jump and disorderly-liquidity regimes.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Estimate probabilities of trend, mean reversion, range/pin, volatility expansion, contraction, jump and disorderly-liquidity regimes.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Options/dealer regime probabilities are inferred from model/state.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Estimate probabilities of positive/negative gamma, event-vol build, vol crush, pinning and liquidity-stress regimes.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Estimate probabilities of positive/negative gamma, event-vol build, vol crush, pinning and liquidity-stress regimes.

Individual_Classification_Reason: A typed market-state vector is assembly; components may themselves be models/policy-weighted.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Assemble validated macro, market, sector, NVDA, surface, flow, liquidity, event and time features with uncertainty metadata.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Assemble validated macro, market, sector, NVDA, surface, flow, liquidity, event and time features with uncertainty metadata.

Individual_Classification_Reason: A dependence matrix is an estimated statistical relationship among assembled candidate signals.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Estimate correlations/conditional dependencies among candidate signals to distinguish independent confirmation from duplicated information.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Estimate correlations/conditional dependencies among candidate signals to distinguish independent confirmation from duplicated information.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Conflict score discounts correlated information with configured weights.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Measure directional/regime disagreement after discounting correlated duplicate signals.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Measure directional/regime disagreement after discounting correlated duplicate signals.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Composite data-quality score combines unrelated quality measures with configured weighting.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Combine freshness, completeness, time alignment and surface consistency into a quality score.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Combine freshness, completeness, time alignment and surface consistency into a quality score.
Effective_Brief_Rule_Ref: §5 K07_WEIGHTED_SCORE — apply kernel to this row concept

Individual_Classification_Reason: Tradeability score is a configured state-quality assessment, before any definitive allow/deny policy.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Assess whether uncertainty is bounded enough and the state sufficiently distinct to support a decision.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Assess whether uncertainty is bounded enough and the state sufficiently distinct to support a decision.
Effective_Brief_Rule_Ref: §5 K07_WEIGHTED_SCORE — apply kernel to this row concept

Individual_Classification_Reason: A conditional joint scenario set is inferred, forecast-like, with spot/IV/sector/rates/liquidity paths.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Generate probability-weighted joint paths for spot, realised vol, IV surface, skew, sector, rates and liquidity.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Generate probability-weighted joint paths for spot, realised vol, IV surface, skew, sector, rates and liquidity.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Expected candidate P&L is a prospective amount over candidate exposures and scenarios.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Value each candidate delta/volatility/convexity/skew/term exposure across weighted scenarios before costs.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Value each candidate delta/volatility/convexity/skew/term exposure across weighted scenarios before costs.
Effective_Binding_Note: Candidate P&L comes from aligned D174 matrix; D160 supplies weights.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Tail/CVaR candidate exposure is a prospective economic risk amount, not an allowable limit.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Estimate expected loss in the defined worst-tail of scenario outcomes.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Estimate expected loss in the defined worst-tail of scenario outcomes.
Effective_Binding_Note: Candidate P&L comes from D174; percent VaR/CVaR denominator is CandidateStructureContext.risk_capital_currency.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Uncertainty penalty is configured scoring used to adjust a later utility/decision.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Penalise candidate decisions whose edge is highly sensitive to model assumptions or weakly identified state.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Penalise candidate decisions whose edge is highly sensitive to model assumptions or weakly identified state.
Effective_Brief_Rule_Ref: §5 K07_WEIGHTED_SCORE — apply kernel to this row concept

Individual_Classification_Reason: Total expected costs are prospective candidate/order-intent economics under versioned fee schedules.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Combine expected spread/slippage, commissions and multi-leg execution costs.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Combine expected spread/slippage, commissions and multi-leg execution costs.
Effective_Binding_Note: Pre-trade expected cost; realised R233 removed and replaced by immutable ExecutionCostScheduleVersion. All three typed contexts are required; semicolon denotes conjunction.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Expected utility applies selected risk/utility policy to measured P&L, costs and risk.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Compare expected reward with tail-risk, model-risk and execution-cost penalties under the selected utility/risk policy.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Compare expected reward with tail-risk, model-risk and execution-cost penalties under the selected utility/risk policy.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Tradeable distribution is an allow/deny policy threshold applied to quality and utility.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Allow trade consideration only if state quality/identifiability and net expected utility clear configured thresholds.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Allow trade consideration only if state quality/identifiability and net expected utility clear configured thresholds.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Selected exposure is a categorical strategy selection, not market evidence.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Choose among directional delta, volatility, convexity, skew, term-structure, relative-value or no-trade exposures.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Choose among directional delta, volatility, convexity, skew, term-structure, relative-value or no-trade exposures.
Effective_Binding_Note: Selection universe and deterministic ordering come from CandidateSetContext.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Greek aggregation describes the exposure of a candidate structure, not market-wide dealer exposure.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Aggregate leg-level Greeks and multipliers into structure-level exposures.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Aggregate leg-level Greeks and multipliers into structure-level exposures.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Maximum loss depends on candidate payoff/topology and possible scenario convention.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Determine contractual maximum loss where bounded; otherwise scenario/stress-based loss.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Determine contractual maximum loss where bounded; otherwise scenario/stress-based loss.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Breakeven points depend on candidate strikes/leg topology and premiums.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Determine terminal breakeven price points from premiums and strike topology.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Determine terminal breakeven price points from premiums and strike topology.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Expiry suitability is configured scoring of a candidate option-expiry choice.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Score each expiry for event coverage, theta burden, gamma/vega profile, term pricing, liquidity and thesis-delay robustness.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Score each expiry for event coverage, theta burden, gamma/vega profile, term pricing, liquidity and thesis-delay robustness.
Effective_Brief_Rule_Ref: §5 K07_WEIGHTED_SCORE — apply kernel to this row concept

Individual_Classification_Reason: Strike suitability is configured scoring of a candidate contract choice.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Score each strike for target delta/exposure, distribution support, skew relative value, liquidity and model robustness.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Score each strike for target delta/exposure, distribution support, skew relative value, liquidity and model robustness.
Effective_Brief_Rule_Ref: §5 K07_WEIGHTED_SCORE — apply kernel to this row concept

Individual_Classification_Reason: Neighbour comparison is configured scoring of alternative candidate choices.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Compare adjacent strikes/expiries and approximately equivalent exposure implementations against the candidate.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Compare adjacent strikes/expiries and approximately equivalent exposure implementations against the candidate.
Effective_Brief_Rule_Ref: §5 K07_WEIGHTED_SCORE — apply kernel to this row concept
Effective_Binding_Note: CandidateSetContext supplies the explicit neighbour relation for the subject candidate.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Stress-loss matrix is a candidate-specific revaluation result, not a permissible capital limit.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Revalue candidate under spot gaps, IV shifts, skew rotations, thesis delay/failure and liquidity deterioration.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Revalue candidate under spot gaps, IV shifts, skew rotations, thesis delay/failure and liquidity deterioration.
Effective_Binding_Note: Gross candidate scenario P&L only; D164 execution cost is excluded here and deducted exactly once in D165.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Maximum permissible position risk is a risk-limit policy, distinct from measured candidate CVaR/stress.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Set maximum allowed loss/exposure from portfolio capital, liquidity, tail loss, stress and concentration limits.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Set maximum allowed loss/exposure from portfolio capital, liquidity, tail loss, stress and concentration limits.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Recommended size is a sizing policy using risk budget, utility and liquidity.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Size the candidate within risk budget while reducing size for model uncertainty, tail risk and liquidity limits.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Size the candidate within risk budget while reducing size for model uncertainty, tail risk and liquidity limits.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Current executable entry edge is a prospective economic valuation after costs.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Recompute net advantage at the current executable market immediately before order submission.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Recompute net advantage at the current executable market immediately before order submission.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Limit target selects an execution action price using urgency and minimum edge policy.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Choose a limit relative to current quotes/depth and urgency while preserving minimum required edge.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Choose a limit relative to current quotes/depth and urgency while preserving minimum required edge.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Slippage is realised fill against arrival benchmark, not forecast cost.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Difference between realised execution price and decision/arrival benchmark, signed by trade direction.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Difference between realised execution price and decision/arrival benchmark, signed by trade direction.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Completion ratio measures executed fraction of an order, not an instruction.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Filled quantity relative to requested/total quantity.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Filled quantity relative to requested/total quantity.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Live delta is current holdings times live Greeks, not prospective candidate exposure.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Aggregate position quantity times live option delta/multiplier across legs and stock.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Aggregate position quantity times live option delta/multiplier across legs and stock.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Live gamma is current holdings exposure.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Aggregate live gamma across positions.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Aggregate live gamma across positions.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Live vega is current holdings exposure.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Aggregate live vega across positions.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Aggregate live vega across positions.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Live theta is current holdings exposure.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Aggregate live theta across positions.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Aggregate live theta across positions.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Live P&L combines current IBKR position/account fields.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Combine IBKR live P&L fields while preserving realised/unrealised separation.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Combine IBKR live P&L fields while preserving realised/unrealised separation.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Current-vs-entry similarity applies a stored thesis/entry-state comparison rule.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Compare current state with stored entry-state vector and track which assumptions have materially changed.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Compare current state with stored entry-state vector and track which assumptions have materially changed.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Invalidation score is configured thesis-failure aggregation, distinct from a final exit decision.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Aggregate predefined thesis-failure, regime-change, liquidity and time-decay conditions into an invalidation state.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Aggregate predefined thesis-failure, regime-change, liquidity and time-decay conditions into an invalidation state.
Effective_Brief_Rule_Ref: §5 K07_WEIGHTED_SCORE — apply kernel to this row concept

Individual_Classification_Reason: Continuation value is prospective valuation of an existing position, not a decision to hold.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Expected utility of keeping the current position from now versus closing/restructuring.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Expected utility of keeping the current position from now versus closing/restructuring.
Effective_Binding_Note: LivePositionContext supplies exact current leg/quantity/contract occurrence references for revaluation.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Required hedge is a normative decision about permissible exposure bands, not measured Greeks.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Identify unwanted live exposures exceeding target bands while core thesis remains valid.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Identify unwanted live exposures exceeding target bands while core thesis remains valid.
Effective_Binding_Note: Adds D184 theta exposure and D175 risk-limit clipping.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Modification value compares economic alternatives for a live position; no order is selected.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Compare expected utility of candidate rolls/reshapes/reductions with holding and immediate exit after costs.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Compare expected utility of candidate rolls/reshapes/reductions with holding and immediate exit after costs.
Effective_Binding_Note: Best modification is selected from CandidateSetContext using D165; D165 already includes candidate-specific D164 execution cost.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Immediate exit value is economic liquidation value after expected costs; not an instruction.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Executable liquidation value net of expected slippage and commissions.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Executable liquidation value net of expected slippage and commissions.
Effective_Binding_Note: Executable fill from D133 embeds slippage; subtract only the non-slippage commissions/fees component retained in D164 so slippage is counted once.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Hold/hedge/modify/exit is explicit policy/action state.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Select hold, hedge, modify or exit subject to risk constraints and current expected utility.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Select hold, hedge, modify or exit subject to risk constraints and current expected utility.
Effective_Binding_Note: Deterministic action precedence; D189 hedge vector is never value-ranked, D190 is tested in its declared utility domain, and exit-vs-hold compares D191 currency with D188 expected_currency_PnL.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Realised costs measure actual fills and commissions.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Measure realised spread/slippage plus commissions against the decision/arrival benchmark.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Measure realised spread/slippage plus commissions against the decision/arrival benchmark.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Delta P&L attribution is a path decomposition under attribution convention.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Attribute P&L associated with underlying price movement using contemporaneous delta path.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Attribute P&L associated with underlying price movement using contemporaneous delta path.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Gamma P&L attribution is a path decomposition under attribution convention.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Attribute convexity P&L associated with realised underlying variance after delta component.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Attribute convexity P&L associated with realised underlying variance after delta component.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Vega P&L attribution is a path decomposition under attribution convention.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Attribute P&L associated with implied-volatility changes using live vega and surface movement.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Attribute P&L associated with implied-volatility changes using live vega and surface movement.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Theta P&L attribution is a path decomposition under attribution convention.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Attribute time-decay contribution over elapsed holding time.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Attribute time-decay contribution over elapsed holding time.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Skew P&L attribution is a path decomposition under attribution/revaluation convention.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Attribute residual option P&L associated with relative strike/skew movement after broad IV movement.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Attribute residual option P&L associated with relative strike/skew movement after broad IV movement.
Effective_Binding_Note: Adds D196 explicitly because skew residual subtracts parallel-vega attribution.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Unexplained P&L is the residual of the attribution decomposition.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Observed P&L minus explained attribution components.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Observed P&L minus explained attribution components.
Effective_Binding_Note: D193 subtraction conditional on provider P&L gross/net convention.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Decision-quality score evaluates past information-set justification, not a live trading score.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Score whether the decision was justified by the information and calibrated distribution available at decision time, regardless of realised P&L.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Score whether the decision was justified by the information and calibrated distribution available at decision time, regardless of realised P&L.
Effective_Brief_Rule_Ref: §5 K07_WEIGHTED_SCORE — apply kernel to this row concept

Individual_Classification_Reason: Counterfactuals evaluate locked past choices on a subsequent observed path; not live scenario forecasts.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Revalue no-trade, alternative strike/expiry/structure/timing/hedge/exit choices on realised subsequent path without altering historical information set.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Revalue no-trade, alternative strike/expiry/structure/timing/hedge/exit choices on realised subsequent path without altering historical information set.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Incremental information value is out-of-sample evaluation, not the original signal itself.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Measure out-of-sample incremental predictive/decision value after controlling for existing signals and regime.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Measure out-of-sample incremental predictive/decision value after controlling for existing signals and regime.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Calibration error is realised-outcome assessment of probability forecasts.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Compare forecast probability bins/distributions with realised frequencies using proper calibration diagnostics.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Compare forecast probability bins/distributions with realised frequencies using proper calibration diagnostics.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Brier score evaluates past binary probability forecast/outcome pairs.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Proper scoring rule for binary probabilistic forecasts such as tradeable/no-trade or regime events.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Proper scoring rule for binary probabilistic forecasts such as tradeable/no-trade or regime events.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Log score evaluates past distribution forecasts and realised outcomes.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Proper scoring rule for probabilistic/distribution forecasts.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Proper scoring rule for probabilistic/distribution forecasts.

Individual_Classification_Reason: OOS decision performance uses historically locked model and realised costs.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Evaluate locked model/version on unseen periods including transaction costs and regime segmentation.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Evaluate locked model/version on unseen periods including transaction costs and regime segmentation.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Model drift score evaluates degradation in calibration, usefulness and costs.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Track deterioration in calibration, signal value, costs and out-of-sample performance relative to training/validation baselines.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Track deterioration in calibration, signal value, costs and out-of-sample performance relative to training/validation baselines.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Signal disposition is a governed review classification that constrains future signal use.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Classify each signal as general, regime-specific, veto-only, sizing-only, implementation-only or non-informative.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Classify each signal as general, regime-specific, veto-only, sizing-only, implementation-only or non-informative.

Individual_Classification_Reason: Next update trigger schedules observation/recomputation, not a brokerage trade action.
Original_Calculation_Concept: Continue the observe-state-infer-act loop on the next market/data event or scheduled recalculation.
Effective_Calculation_Concept: Continue the observe-state-infer-act loop on the next market/data event or scheduled recalculation.
Effective_Binding_Note: R001 supplies the admitted M00 receipt event; RecalculationSchedule supplies the scheduled trigger rule. No separate trigger context is invented.
